newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan, Chile firms to jointly develop copper mine.
newsitem.headline: Japan, Chile firms to jointly develop copper mine.

text.p: Japan's Nittetsu Mining Co Ltd and Itochu Corp and Chile's El Bronce SA have agreed in principle to jointly develop a copper mine in Copiapo, Chile, company spokesmen said on Monday.
Spokesmen for Nittestsu Mining and Itochu said the three firms would start developing the copper mine in early 1998 and planned to start shipping copper concentrate in 2000.

The three firms will invest a total $130 million in the mining project, and are expected to produce nearly 90,000 tonnes of copper concentrate in 2000. "We plan to ship about half of the output to Japan," a Nittetsu Mining spokesman said.
